title: Lions of the World:
title_short: Hong Kong global montage · I'm from here
length: about 53 s (48 s of Lions, then the 5 s end card)
headline: Lions from every corner of the world are one family. The fun is how many places they come from, said fast, one after another.
story: Maria and Elidia from Mexico open it. Then Hong Kong, Ontario, Germany, Hawaii, Indonesia, Italy and more, one or two seconds each.
One slower beat: a Lion from Bitola who found Lions from home in Melbourne. A Leo laughs that she's actually from Hong Kong.

Loops: L1 “Where are these Lions from?” opens at 0:00 and keeps closing with every country. L2 “Why did they all fly to the same hall?” closes in the button: new friends from all over the world, best friends now, and Lions who feel like family.
do: Hook text WHERE ARE YOU FROM? on frame 1 over Maria.
Run the “I'm from” lines fast, 1 to 2 s each, in the order below.
Change costume, age and setting every cut.
One small country super per speaker, from 0:03: a pin and the country only.
Cut to the end card on “feeling”.
dont: No service projects, club titles, awards or convention schedule.
No names, club names or titles on screen (Jacqui, 13 Aug: names slow approvals).
No Taiwan flag in any frame. No election candidate signage or clothing. No Paris Lion “I'm from Taiwan” lines unless Jacqui says yes.
No editor-added logos. Lions lockup on the end card only.

tech: iPhone, vertical 1080×1920, about 30 fps (29.98 to 30.0; IMG_7935 is 28.2), audio in camera (visual.json).
1080×1920 at 29.97 fps. Conform the odd clip; no other frame-rate change.
Native vertical. No 9:16 crop needed. Every punch-in is an upscale, so keep it at 110% or less.

Phone mic, recorded into the camera. If Atdhe's voice is louder than the subject (he holds the phone), ride his lines down 4 to 6 dB. Keep a little room sound under every voice; don't fully clean it (Jacqui, 20 Oct).
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Music 18 to 20 dB under the voice. Lions flagged loud music before.
Natural skin: pull the saturation down, the hall light makes skin orange (Jacqui, 20 Oct).

White text on a semi-transparent background box (the locked Lions caption style). No drop shadow. Max 2 lines. Keep the bottom 20% clear for app buttons. Every word matches the audio; Lion and Lions with a capital L. The caption clips are in the Captions section of this page.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file, 9:16 only.
checklist: Frame 1 is Maria with WHERE ARE YOU FROM?. No logo, name plate or title.

Country supers only, from 0:03, spelled exactly: Mexico, Hong Kong, Canada, Germany, Hawaii USA, Indonesia, Italy, North Macedonia / Australia, Uganda, Netherlands, USA, Puerto Rico, Zimbabwe, Philippines, Hong Kong, Uganda, Thailand.
No names, club names or titles on supers. Hawaii and Uganda start on the place, not the club.
No Taiwan flag and no candidate signage in any frame. No Paris Lion “I'm from Taiwan” line.
Natural skin: saturation down (the hall light makes skin orange).
A little room sound under every voice. Don't fully clean it.
“Leo” is one member, “Leos” the youth group. Lion and Lions with a capital L.
Lions end card video on the end only. No editor-added logos.

decisions.b: The Monday item asks for about 30 to 45 s. With every brief line cut to 1 to 2 s, the Lions run 48 s and the end card adds 5 s. Nick decides if two or three countries come out (the two USA lines and Zimbabwe are the easiest).

decisions.t: Two names to check by ear
decisions.b: The transcript hears “Leola and Lona” (Zimbabwe) and “51st Street” (Puerto Rico). Both are in the captions as heard. Nick or Bleron confirms by ear before delivery.
